text:
mina_cs: Heads-up from Rachel at LatticeArc (pilot). They migrated a project folder into a new workspace and now 2 power-users can't access the CLI or the web app. Concerned about the pilot momentum and upcoming renewal convo. Can infra triage and we should offer an enablement refresh + capture feedback.

josiah_infra: On it. Do we have the org and workspace IDs? Any error messages from users?

mina_cs: Org LA-331, workspace w-77. Users report 403 on CLI and 'no access to workspace' in UI. Rachel pasted error: "Authorization failed: organization not found for key".

ops-bot: incident 1749999999 created: label=pilot-migration severity=medium

josiah_infra: Quick hypothesis: migration created a dangling org_id reference for API keys. Running `infra-cli get-keys --org LA-331 --workspace w-77`. Will rebind keys if needed. ETA 30m.

ivy_enable: I can prep a 20m enablement + migration checklist for tomorrow 11:00am PT and record. Will include steps for API key rotation, CLI re-auth, and a 3-question pulse.

rachel_cust: 11:00am PT works. We're nervous — two of our evaluators were about to demo to the execs. If you can get temp access for them that would be huge.

josiah_infra: Found cause: two API keys still bound to old workspace id. Rebinding now: `infra-cli rebind-key --key k_abc123 --to-workspace w-77` -> success. Rotated keys for affected users and emailed temporary keys. Logs: 
```
2024-06-05T09:14:02Z key-check: k_abc123 bound to w-19
2024-06-05T09:14:15Z rebind: k_abc123 -> w-77 OK
2024-06-05T09:14:20Z notify: temp-keys sent to alice@latticearc.com,bob@latticearc.com
```

rachel_cust: Got the temp keys, CLI auth passed, web access restored. Really appreciate the fast turnaround.

mina_cs: Action items recap:
1) josiah_infra: add post-migration key validation to runbook and follow up with root cause note
2) ivy_enable: run 20m recorded session 11:00am PT about rotation + CLI re-auth, attach checklist
3) mina_cs: send remediation summary and feedback link; I'll mark renewal-risk as "monitor" and follow-up in 48h

ops-bot: deploy 1750000030: runbook update pr #488 merged by josiah_infra

ivy_enable: Session scheduled & recording link will be shared after. Draft checklist: "rotate keys -> run `redwood login` -> verify workspace with `redwood whoami` -> resend invites if roles missing". Feedback form: 3 quick items (ease, confidence, recommend).

mina_cs: Rachel, would you mind completing the pulse after the session? Even a short score helps us decide further touchpoints.

rachel_cust: Sure — will fill it out. So far 5/5 for response time. Thank you! 

mina_cs: Closing loop for now. I'll paste the feedback snippet here once received and update SFDC. Great cross-team move :heart:
